card.name: Going to the emergency room
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about going to the hospital or emergency room, such as "to" after "go" or "taken", and "nearest", "emergency" or "room" in "emergency room/department". Seen in advice on when to seek urgent care.

modes.label: "to" after go or taken
modes.description: The word "to" right after a verb of going or being taken, just before the nearest hospital or emergency room.
modes.example: If you have any of these symptoms, call your healthcare provider or go<< to>> the nearest hospital emergency room right away.

modes.label: Inside emergency room phrase
modes.description: "emergency", "room" or "nearest" inside a phrase naming the emergency room or department.
modes.example: an overdose, patients should contact a physician, poison control center (1-800-222-1222), or emergency<< room>>.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict hospital words next, such as hospital, hospitals and the Chinese 医院.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is telling someone to head to the hospital or emergency room.
